name: oorexx_bosh_api_client_adapter
role: optional HTTP exchange adapter from generic BOSH to ooRexx API Client

authority.api_client: HTTP framing, redirect policy, TLS, egress/session/admission

xtp.note: HTTPS-over-XTP requires an API Client/lower transport backend that can acquire XTP through the shared selector; this adapter does not select XTP.

object_preservation.request_headers: same ooRexx object supplied to ApiRequest
object_preservation.response_headers: ApiResponse headers retained in BoshHttpResponse metadata
